$comment: Machine-readable version of FLOW.md for agents. Query it with: python3 code_quality/scripts/flow_graph.py (show|next|path|mermaid|validate). Paths in 'refs' and 'command' are relative to the repo root. Keep in sync with FLOW.md; `validate` checks every edge and file reference.
goal: Minimum total human minutes per successful change without raising revert or incident rate.

task.title: Task contract
task.do: Write acceptance criteria, non-goals and edge cases at the top of the PR description.
task.human: Only if intent is ambiguous AND a wrong guess is expensive.

implement.title: Implement in an isolated worktree
implement.do: One coherent change (<~400 lines). Test for every behavior change. Follow existing patterns. Never weaken a check.
implement.enforced_by: Stop hook runs fast_gate at every turn end; PreToolUse hook blocks edits to the quality system and PR approvals.

full_gate.title: Full gate (lint, types, tests, build, test-integrity signals)

find.title: Find: each configured family hunts independently (read-only, fresh context); the second family joins at deep depth / Tier 2
rules: Every finding: failure scenario + file:line evidence + bug class.

verify.actor: verifier (default claude; deep/T2: every deep family)
verify.title: Verify: a fresh session of the configured verifier family (default Claude; deep/T2: every family in deep_families) tries to disprove each finding, in a throwaway checkout where it may run tests
rules: A failing reproduction is the strongest confirmation; a passing targeted test is strong counter-evidence.
Unresolved Important stays blocking at worst severity.
Open findings from earlier rounds are re-verified at HEAD; fixed ones clear automatically.

repair.title: Repair verified findings
repair.do: Fix the whole bug class, or append a code-backed reason to .quality/responses.json. Settle 'unresolved' with a test. Minimal patch, no unrelated cleanup. Commit.
repair.command: code_quality/scripts/review_loop.sh --intent "<task>"  (runs full_gate -> find -> verify -> repair automatically)

classify.title: Risk tier = max(path floor, model opinion); model may only raise

ci.title: CI reruns gates + review with policy and scripts from the BASE branch

approval.title: Human approvals per tier, on THIS head commit
approval.human: Read .quality/packet.md: right thing to build? pattern worth copying? tier + rollback right? (~5 min T1, ~15 min T2) Solo profile: Tier 2 takes 1 approval (profiles/solo.toml).
rules: Director counts only via a review on head SHA with '/director-approve' on its own line.

merge_queue.title: Merge queue: retest on latest main with the change applied

release.title: Flag off by default -> internal -> canary -> everyone

learn.title: Revert/incident -> reviewer eval case; repeated finding class (3x) -> lint rule / AGENTS.md line
learn.human: Confirm the expected finding of a new eval case once (~10 min).

escalate.title: Round cap hit: step back, is the approach right?
escalate.human: Read .quality/packet.md (escalated). Decide: new approach, narrower scope, or accept risk with T2.

stop_gate_red.title: Gate still red after 3 repair attempts
stop_gate_red.human: Look at the gate logs in .quality/gate-*.log.

stop_tooling.title: Review incomplete: a reviewer/verifier failed (credits, sandbox, CLI). Blocks merge; not a code problem.
stop_tooling.human: Fix tooling (e.g. QUALITY_CODEX_SANDBOX=outer inside a sandbox) and re-run.

t0.examples: docs, copy, comments, locale strings (file types only, never directories); with allow_model_t0: additive code behind a default-off flag (classifier checklist, size-capped, sampled weekly)

t1.examples: ordinary product/behavior changes, caching/retries/concurrency, dependencies, prompts/model settings

t2.examples: auth, secrets, payments, migrations, infra/deploy, CI, the quality system, new patterns

rules: The change sets the tier, not the author.
Path floors are deterministic; the classifier can only raise.
Policy is read from the base branch.
Solo profile (profiles/solo.toml): Tier 2 takes 1 approval, compensated by deep review with both families.

invariants.rule: Lint/types green before a turn ends
Agents don't edit CI, hooks, rules, or policy
No weakened checks without a verified justification
Evidence and approvals are bound to the head SHA
PR cannot change its own policy, prompts, or gate
invariants.enforced_by: CI loads kit from base SHA; CODEOWNERS on workflows

human_touchpoints: weekly audit: 5 T0 merges + noise report (15 min)
changes to the quality system (always T2)
